decisions.reason: The Magento shop template builds on the firm's existing web and e-commerce design knowledge, but its narrow platform focus and only brief website mention make it somewhat easier to discontinue if uptake is weak.
A responsive website template is very close to the firm's core capabilities in digital design and can be improved through routine learning from client projects, so management would likely retain it.
Premium customer support fits naturally with an information-services firm's installed client base and uses knowledge the firm already has, making it a low-risk complement to keep on the market.

A software version management tool draws on related software-development know-how and having its own page suggests strategic commitment, though it is somewhat farther from standard client-facing services than the templates.

The data-processing-contract tool likely benefits from short-term GDPR demand but depends more on legal-compliance expertise that is less central to the firm's existing knowledge base, so management would be relatively likely to withdraw it.
